6a005afe2e294c78bf1f1d0dc807ad56.snippet: Stations: 48 stations of the 1892–93 voyage; 47 with an arrival date. Status: rule-based (dates), machine-made (Kulturpool counts).
6a005afe2e294c78bf1f1d0dc807ad56.description:
Stations. 48 stations of the 1892–93 voyage; 47 with an arrival date.

Status: rule-based (dates), machine-made (Kulturpool counts).

How it was made

  • Stations and their order: the team's vault, matched to Höfer's route overview.
  • Arrival date = end of the leg into the place in Höfer's route overview (not the first mention). 5 dates are estimated.
  • Coordinates and today's names: GeoNames via the team's gazetteer.
  • Kulturpool count: records that name the place and are dated 1890–1895 (voyage years ±2); 16 of 48 stations have at least one. The count is about the place, not the voyage.
  • Corrected on 28 October 2026: two stations had wrong GeoNames matches (Livingston in New Jersey, Wyoming in Michigan) and now sit at Livingston, Montana (the team's hand-set point of the diary day 20.9.1893) and Yellowstone National Park (Wikidata Q351); Tjiandjur's arrival follows Höfer (15.4.1893) instead of an estimate (6.5.1893).

Checks

  • Höfer's route against the diary: 143 of 170 diary days name the same place by string, 14 differ (spelling or OCR, read by an AI agent; not checked by a person).

Diary, day by day. 216 of the diary's 309 days have a place and are on the map.

Status: machine-made, unchecked (dates partly rule-based); coordinate origin given per day.

How it was made

  • Day date: 84 days have an entry of their own, 129 are part of a multi-day entry and were assigned by matching the team's English day page, 3 have no entry of their own. OCR lost many headings, so an assigned date can be 1–5 days early.
  • Coordinate basis per day (team field coord_source): Wikidata 98, GeoNames 63, estimated 15, set by hand (approximate) 40; 169 days link their Wikidata or GeoNames record in the pop-up ('Beleg').
  • Coordinate method: hunting place 87, camp or station of a hunting place 28, place in the day's heading 37, same place on another day 17, hand list 41, route place 6.
  • Every day links to its page scan; quote from the scan, not from the OCR.

map.description:
Demo for Hack the Pool 2026 (Kulturpool, ÖAW, 27–28 October 2026). The voyage of the cruiser SMS Kaiserin Elisabeth with Archduke Franz Ferdinand, 15 December 1892 to 18 October 1893, read against the grain: beside the route, the diary's hunts and kills, the collection, the press and the photographs. Each layer's description says where its data comes from, how it was made and what has been checked; each pop-up links the single record (scan, newspaper page, museum object).

How to read the status

  • checked by a person: a named check by a team member exists
  • machine-made, unchecked: produced by a script, OCR or a match; a proposal until a person checks it
  • rule-based: follows a fixed, written rule (e.g. arrival date = end of the leg); can be wrong where the rule does not fit

Layers

  • Stations: rule-based (dates), machine-made (Kulturpool counts)
  • Legs (straight lines): rule-based
  • Diary, day by day: machine-made, unchecked (dates partly rule-based); coordinate origin given per day
  • Hunts (according to the diary): machine-made, unchecked
  • Kill entries in the diary (per day): machine-made, unchecked
  • Este collection: purchase or gift documented: machine-made, unchecked (proposals with evidence)
  • Press (ANNO, unchecked): machine-made, unchecked
  • Photographs, Weltmuseum Wien: rule-based (place), licence per record

Sources

  • ANNO – AustriaN Newspapers Online, Österreichische Nationalbibliothek. https://anno.onb.ac.at/ (link and short quotation only)
  • Franz Ferdinand von Österreich-Este: Tagebuch meiner Reise um die Erde 1892–1893. 2 vols. Wien: Alfred Hölder, 1895. https://archive.org/details/tagebuchmeinerr01ferdgoog (public domain (scans); OCR text by the Internet Archive)
  • Europeana: records of the Weltmuseum Wien photographs of the voyage, delivered through Kulturpool. https://www.europeana.eu/ (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 for the labelled photographs (per record))
  • GeoNames geographical database. https://www.geonames.org/ (CC BY 4.0)
  • Regina Höfer (ed.): Imperial Sightseeing. Die Indienreise von Erzherzog Franz Ferdinand von Österreich-Este. Wien 2010. doi:10.11588/xarep.00001404. https://doi.org/10.11588/xarep.00001404 (in copyright; only dates, places and page numbers are used, no text or images)
  • Kulturpool: search API (api.kulturpool.at/search), queried 27 October 2026; portal search kulturpool.at/suche. https://kulturpool.at/ (licence per record (shown in the pop-up))
  • KHM team, Hack the Pool 2026: research vault (Obsidian), normalised JSON (normalization/json) and enrichment pipeline (Kriegsmarine/enrichment), branch khm-team at commits b5e1464 and a4b8b5a (see each layer). https://github.com/RichterHenje/Hack-The-Pool-2026/tree/khm-team/Kriegsmarine
